ios.desc:
Take back control of your screen time and get fit at the same time.
Free to use — no subscription needed.
HonorFit Blocker (Honor Fit) shields your most distracting apps (social media, games, video feeds) until you earn them with physical exercise. Log your pushups, pull-ups, situps, or squats on our smooth rep wheels, and instantly convert physical reps into screen time minutes. Into yoga or pilates? Log them as timed workouts, in minutes. Kegels, glute bridges and more are one tap away too.
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Select Apps to Block — Choose the time-sink apps you want to restrict using Apple Screen Time.
2. Apps Lock Automatically — When your earned time balance runs out, the shield goes up.
3. Rep to Unlock — Drop down, do your pushups, log your reps on the honor system wheel, and earn minutes to spend.
WHY HONORFIT WORKS:
• Positive Friction: Replaces mindless doomscrolling with quick calisthenic workouts.
• Central Balance: Earn time in advance or unlock access on demand when you hit a shield.
• Pure Honor System: No awkward camera tracking or battery drain — just honest rep logging.
• 100% Private: All screen time management happens entirely on your device. No accounts, no data tracking, and no external servers.
KEY FEATURES (FREE FOR EVERYONE):
• Apple Screen Time & Family Controls Integration
• Smooth interactive rep wheels (up to 100) for Pushups, Situps, Squats, and Pull-ups
• Add up to 3 exercises of your own: burpees, plank, kegels, glute bridges and more
• Timed workouts logged in minutes: yoga, pilates, HIIT, running, walking, meditation
• Rename, reorder, or remove exercises
• Custom exchange rates: Customize how much screen time each rep or minute earns
• Hard mode (every rep earns half), a daily baseline of free minutes, and reset at midnight
• Bank up to 2 hours of earned time
• Silence the time-left notification
• Stats with a week chart, plus daily streaks
• Dark mode UI designed for speed and focus
HONORFIT PRO (one-time lifetime unlock or monthly):
• Bank unlimited time and add unlimited exercises
• Saved routines: one-tap rep combos
• Pause mode, with a tally of what it cost you
• Owe mode: take the time now, do the reps later
• Month and year history charts
• Support an indie, privacy-first app
Turn your screen addiction into physical strength with HonorFit Blocker!

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://honorfitapp.com/privacy/

android.desc:
Turn mindless scrolling into physical strength. HonorFit Blocker (Honor Fit) is a workout app blocker: it locks your distracting apps and turns your exercise reps into screen time currency.

Free to use, no subscription needed. Into yoga or pilates? Log them as timed workouts in minutes. Kegels, glute bridges and more are one tap away too.

Want to browse social media, stream videos, or play games? Earn it first with pushups, squats, pull-ups, and sit-ups!

💪 HOW IT WORKS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. CHOOSE YOUR APPS: Select the apps that steal your focus (social media, video streaming, games).
2. SET YOUR RULES: Assign how many minutes of screen time each rep earns.
3. DO THE WORK: When you hit a blocked app, drop down and log your reps on the simple honor-system rep wheel.
4. SPEND YOUR TIME: Enjoy your earned screen time. The countdown only runs while you are actively inside a blocked app—switch away and the timer pauses!
5. STAY CONSISTENT: When your time runs out, the apps lock again and HonorFit drops you back on the rep wheels to earn more.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ KEY FEATURES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Active Session Metering: Your earned balance only drains while you are actively using a restricted app. Switch away, and your timer stops.
• Honor-System Simplicity: No invasive cameras, no posture AI, no complicated setup. Just fast, frictionless rep logging.
• Central Balance Pool: Earn time across multiple exercises and spend it freely across any of your blocked apps.
• Streaks & Progress Tracking: Track your daily pushups, completed workouts, and habit streaks over time.
• Your Exercises, Free: Rename the built-ins, add up to 3 of your own (kegels, glute bridges, burpees…), log timed workouts like yoga or pilates, and set what every rep earns. Bank up to 2 hours.
• Share Your Wins: After a workout, share an image card of what your reps earned, streak included.
• Pro (optional): unlimited exercises and banked time, saved routines, pause and owe modes, and month/year history.
• Dark Mode UI: Clean, distraction-free aesthetic designed for rapid logging.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🚫 ZERO AI
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
None. Not a drop. No AI rep counting, no machine-learning form detection, no cloud processing, no chatbot coach. You log your own reps — if you cheat, the only person you are lying to is the one doing zero pushups.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔒 100% PRIVATE & ON-DEVICE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Your data belongs exclusively to
